## About these tutorials

This series introduces methods for analysing eDNA metabarcoding data using R.

The tutorials combine explanations, executable code, and interpretation
of analytical outputs.

## Tutorial sequence

Work through the sessions in the following order:

1. [Session 0: Getting started](session0.html)
2. [Session 1: Diversity and regression](session1.html)
3. [Session 2: RDA and indicator species analysis](session2.html)
4. [Session 3: Joint species distribution models](session3.html)

The tutorial pages are currently under development.

## How to use the tutorials

Read the explanations alongside the code and run the examples locally.

Each completed tutorial will describe its required packages, input data,
and preparation steps.

Although the sessions build on earlier concepts, each page will load
the inputs needed for its own analysis.
